n1.speaker: npc_grist
n1.text: No. Same stair, same cuffs, same answer. I admire the persistence.

up.speaker: npc_grist
up.text: Appeals. Envoys. Carpets. I've not been up myself. I guard the bottom of it.

down.speaker: npc_grist
down.text: Envoys. Last week an angel, Seraph-Grade Assessor, Third Choir. Asked me to sign for her halo.

down2.speaker: npc_grist
down2.text: I don't sign for things I can't count.

weather.speaker: npc_grist
weather.text: Gilt side's bright today. Hurts the eyes. I prefer it when there's cloud.
